rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken verb for arriving or reaching a place.

example.english: I arrive at the office at six.
example.jyutping: ngo5 luk6 dim2 dou3 gung1 si1

rows.note: Use this when highlighting getting to or reaching the destination, often with a sense of movement toward it.

example.english: I only arrive at the beach after walking for an hour.
example.traditional: 我行咗成個鐘先去到海灘。
example.jyutping: ngo5 haang4 zo2 sing4 go3 zung1 sin1 heoi3 dou3 hoi2 taan1
